core_obligations: Reduce the claim to the algebraic statement about A -> B -> C for local rings (proof lines 6987-6992).
Forward direction: if A -> B is flat then A -> C is flat by composition of flat maps (proof lines 6993-6994).
Converse direction: observe B -> C is faithfully flat, then descend flatness from A -> C to A -> B (proof lines 6995-7000).
proof_roadmap: Converse direction via faithful flatness (proof lines 6995-7002).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that flatness is fpqc local on the source (statement lines 6981-6984). The proof first reduces to a concrete algebraic statement -- for local homomorphisms A -> B -> C of local rings with B -> C flat, A -> B is flat if and only if A -> C is flat -- then proves both directions: if A -> B is flat then so is A -> C by composition, and conversely B -> C is faithfully flat so flatness of A -> C descends to A -> B (proof lines 6986-7002). The level is H2: the reduction from the geometric statement to local rings is stated, and the two directions are each given with the named algebra input.
